jake_ops: Kicking off deploy for inference-service v3.14.0. Plan: staggered feature-flag ramp using the cohort broker. Starting canary now at 1%. Deploybot will post preflight and status here.

deploybot: [deploybot] Preflight OK — infra healthy, canary pool available, no DB migrations. Initiating canary traffic: new_routing_v3 -> 1% for 10m soak.

lee_sre: I'll monitor 95p latency and error rate. Abort criteria: 95p > 250ms OR errors > 0.5% sustained for 5m.

emily_eng: Please pin the model-route for canary cohort to avoid fallbacks — pin to v3.14.0.

jake_ops: Pushed FF config:```
feature_flag: "new_routing_v3"
cohorts: ["canary","region-eu","global"]
weights:
  canary: 1%
  region-eu: 10%
  global: 0%
pinned_version: "v3.14.0"
rollout_window: "2h"
```

deploybot: Canary live at 1% — traffic routed to v3.14.0. Telemetry stream started (trace id r-6255x).

release_notes_bot: Reminder: add a release notes bullet: "Model routing v3.14.0 — cohort broker roll (canary)" and update changelog before wider rollout.

lee_sre: Adding temporary alert rules and dashboard: reroute_95p, request_error_pct, rerank_accuracy_delta. Will page on SLO breach.

emily_eng: Ramp plan we agreed: 1% -> 5% after 10m if stable -> 25% after 30m -> 100% after 2h. Rollback target: revert route to v3.13.7 and pin if quality reg drops > 1% or user-facing errors spike.

kate_prod: FYI product impact: small reranking change. Primary metric: rerank_accuracy. Customers: none in canary cohort. Docs updated in staging.

jake_ops: Acknowledged. I'll watch telemetry. Command to abort: `deploybot abort --thread 6255551234`.

deploybot: Canary 5m snapshot: latency +2ms (baseline), error rate 0.02%, rerank_accuracy delta -0.1% (within accepted delta). Proceeding to 5% in 5m.

emily_eng: Good. Snap prefix cache for quick rollback: create snapshot now.

jake_ops: Snapshot created: `prefix-cache-snap-2026-03-21-10`

lee_sre: Noting a small uptick in 95p for eu region; holding further ramp for 10m to investigate.

deploybot: Ramp paused at canary per request (holding at 5% for now). Will auto-resume at 6255551290 unless manual action taken.

emily_eng: I'll reduce region-eu weight to 5% to isolate and reduce noise.

jake_ops: Applied region-eu -> 5%.

deploybot: Weights updated. Continuing to monitor.

kate_prod: Tagging release notes: "canary paused — eu latency observed" on the changelog.

jake_ops: If no regression after +10m we proceed to 25%, otherwise we roll back. @lee_sre please call it either "resume" or "rollback" here once you have a verdict.

lee_sre: SGTM — I'll escalate to pager if it crosses thresholds, otherwise will post "resume" after verification.

jake_ops: Thanks all :thumbsup:
